_comment: Copy to console_config.json in the repo root and edit. Every key is optional; the sidecar falls back to the defaults baked into console_sidecar.py. console_config.json is NOT read from argv, so no secret ever lands in a process listing.
_claude_path: Absolute path to claude.exe. null = shutil.which('claude'). A .cmd/.bat shim is refused: killing a shim leaves node alive holding a paid session.
_python_path: Interpreter used to launch reaper_mcp.py as the MCP server. null = the interpreter running the sidecar.
_daily_budget_usd: Hard stop enforced by the sidecar, persisted across restarts in console/cost.json. --max-budget-usd is advisory and latching, so this is the real cap.
_turn_warn_usd: A turn costing more than this blocks the NEXT Send until the panel sends an ack_warn control file. There is no cheap mid-turn ceiling, so the gate is pre-flight on the following turn.
_cli_max_budget_usd: Backstop passed to --max-budget-usd. Keep it ABOVE daily_budget_usd: the CLI flag overshoots by one turn and then latches into an unusable session.
_deadman_seconds: Kill the child when panel.json has been stale this long AND the bridge is not mid-render AND no turn is in flight. Must stay above verifyloop.CAPTURE_TIMEOUT_MS (180 s).
_stdin_timeout: How long to wait for a control_response (e.g. the interrupt receipt).
_turn_timeout_seconds: A turn with no result event this long is interrupted, then the child is killed and resumed. Without it a hung turn pins turn_in_flight true and the dead-man switch can never fire.
_event_line_cap: Bytes of text kept per normalized event line. The panel parses these on REAPER's UI thread and one scan_fx result is hundreds of KB. Full text always lands in console/raw/.
_quick_actions: Rendered as buttons by the panel; the sidecar only passes them through in state.json.

quick_actions.label: Profile selected
quick_actions.prompt: Profile the selected drum track and tell me what kit and feel it is.

quick_actions.label: Measure this track
quick_actions.prompt: Measure the selected track and report LUFS-I, peak and whether the capture was isolated.

quick_actions.label: What is wrong with this mix?
quick_actions.prompt: Measure the master bus and name the single biggest problem you can prove from the numbers.
